basic_details.job_title: MSC Bank Representative of Institutional Administrator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra State Co-operative Bank Ltd. (MSC Bank), Mumbai, will appoint one Senior Officer as a Representative of Institutional Administrator on two District Central Cooperative Banks, on contract, with posting at Nagpur. Applications are offline, sent to The Managing Director, The Maharashtra State Co-op. Bank Ltd., Fort, Mumbai, on or before 7 December 2026, under Advertisement No.08 / MSC Bank / 2026-2027.

content_sections.heading: About the Bank and the Posting
content_sections.text: Maharashtra State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is a scheduled bank with its office at Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Smruti Bhavan, Fort, Mumbai. According to the notice, the Government of Maharashtra has appointed the bank as Institutional Administrator on Nagpur District Central Cooperative Bank and Wardha District Central Cooperative Bank. In this regard, MSC Bank wants to appoint a Senior Officer as a Representative of Institutional Administrator on these two DCC Banks. The place of posting is Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who meet the minimum eligibility criteria may submit offline applications to the undersigned on or before 7 December 2026, at this address: The Managing Director, The Maharashtra State Co-op. Bank Ltd., Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Smruti Bhavan, 9, Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce Lane, Fort, Mumbai – 400 001. The notice does not say whether the application should go by post, courier or by hand, and it does not prescribe any wording for the envelope. Use the application form printed with the notice: Annexure-1 – the application form, with a box for a recent passport sized photograph. Sign across the photograph and do not pin or staple it. Annexure-2 – a signed declaration on departmental enquiries, detention or notices from a Statutory Authority, and resignations from previous employers. Annexure-1 asks for the post applied for, full name, date of birth, gender, age as on 01.11.2026 (years and months), category, residential address with PIN code, e-mail ID, mobile number, PAN number, Aadhar number and whether you are domiciled in Maharashtra. It then asks for educational qualifications from 10th standard onwards (board or university, year of passing, % of marks), professional qualifications (CAIIB / DBF / GDCA, certification, others), work experience with each employer (designation, dates of joining and exit, portfolio handled, level of management), achievements, two references and a list of the documents enclosed. It ends with a signed declaration that you will abide by the decisions of the Bank in all matters of this recruitment. The bank's letterhead gives the phone number +91-22-69801000, Post Box No. 472, the email [email protected] and the website https://msc.bank.in .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post, Representative of Institutional Administrator, for a Senior Officer. The eligibility criteria printed in the notice are: Maximum Age Limit: 62 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Essential Qualification: Graduate / Post Graduate in any discipline. Technical qualification: CAIIB / DBF / Diploma in Cooperative Business Management or equivalent qualification. GDC&A would be preferable. Experience: at least 15 years of work experience at the middle & senior level in the Rural Cooperative Banking. Remuneration: will commensurate with the qualification & experience. The notice prints no pay figure. Nature of appointment: purely on contract basis, initially for one year, and may be extended as per performance. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Annexure-1 application form, filled in and signed, with a recent passport sized photograph affixed and signed across Self-attested photocopies of relevant qualification certificates Self-attested photocopies of relevant experience certificates Domicile certificate, if you state that you are domiciled in Maharashtra (the form calls it mandatory in that case) Proof of your expected salary per month and a definite timeline to get relieved from your existing employer, in case you are selected Annexure-2 declaration, signed and dated

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only candidates who meet the minimum eligibility criteria above should apply. In the form, give two references from important Professionals / Government officials, with their full name, designation, organisation, official address, email ID, telephone/mobile number and Aadhar / PAN. In Annexure-2, state whether you have faced any departmental enquiry during service. If yes, give the nature of the allegations and the status of the enquiry. In Annexure-2, state whether you were detained for more than 24 hours or served notices by any Statutory Authority. If yes, give the authority's name, the reasons and the current status. In Annexure-2, state whether you resigned from any previous employer, and give the reasons if yes. List the self-attested photocopies you enclose under item 18 of the form (space for up to 10 documents).

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised by MSC Bank?
faq.answer: MSC Bank will appoint one Senior Officer as Representative of Institutional Administrator on Nagpur and Wardha District Central Cooperative Banks.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Offline applications must be submitted on or before 7 December 2026 to the Managing Director, MSC Bank, Fort, Mumbai – 400 001.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: You must be a Graduate / Post Graduate in any discipline. You also need CAIIB / DBF / Diploma in Cooperative Business Management or an equivalent technical qualification. GDC&A would be preferable.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: You need at least 15 years of work experience at the middle & senior level in the Rural Cooperative Banking.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 62 years as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The notice says the remuneration will commensurate with the qualification & experience. Applicants state their expected monthly salary, with proof, in the application form.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-1 form and the Annexure-2 declaration printed with the notice. Attach self-attested photocopies of your qualification and experience certificates, and submit everything offline to The Managing Director, The Maharashtra State Co-op. Bank Ltd., Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Smruti Bhavan, 9, Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce Lane, Fort, Mumbai – 400 001.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis, initially for one year, and may be extended as per performance.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the place of posting?
faq.answer: The place of posting is Nagpur. The Representative acts on Nagpur District Central Cooperative Bank and Wardha District Central Cooperative Bank.
